messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "rhinoceros", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged mammal standing in right profile with thick shaggy brown fur. It has a broad bear-like head with small rounded ears, dark eyes and a bear-like muzzle, but bearing a long curved dark horn on the nose and a tiny second horn between the eyes. The entire back from behind the head to the rump is covered by a large glossy dark brown domed shell in two sections with fine longitudinal grooves on the rear section and a rim of small rectangular plates along the lower edge. The legs are thick and furry ending in broad clawed paws, and a small furry tail protrudes at the rear beneath the shell.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "bear", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "rhinoceros", "part": "horns", "where": "one long curved horn on the nose and a small horn between the eyes"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs with long claws"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body under the shell"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the entire back from shoulders to rump"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the head, body, legs and tail"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
